files.why: Holds standing work instructions (test before commit, pull requests), recent dated changes (batched uploads, offline queue), and lessons learned from past issues.
Load-bearing rules that must never be broken because each corruption corrupts notes or causes device sync failures, with explicit consequences stated.
Holds coding conventions (component structure, function arguments) and a dated log of work changes (sync worker thread, conflict highlighting).
User-facing README with project description and installation/run instructions, not project memory.
